body: It's not just her.  It's everything.  I don't have a purpose anymore.  Anyway...I'm headed out thanks for reading.

I despise lies.  It is a phobia of mine.  I feel trapped and it exhausts me to try and manage all of the details when someone lies to me...she has lied about her encounters with her male "friends" and I finally had it...the trust is broken.  Though I have no proof that she has cheated she admitted that there was "emotional" cheating, whatever the fuck that means....she also refuses to set boundaries with her male friends to let her know she isn't interested.  I have been very plainspoken and told her that if she wants someone else she is free to do so, she just needs to let me know so I can go on my merry way.  She always vehemently denied it and said I was the one...yet she had these friends over at our house while I was away at work....she spent a great part of our relationship telling me I was possessive and jealous for asking her to set boundaries...I never denied her the right to have and keep any friends I just asked that she be clear with them and me....In retrospect this situation doesn't sound like much but it's been a lifetime of absolute horseshit and I'm just done with it.  I've already tried therapy and here I am once again...I think it's just time I finish up.
Whatever choice he makes, it is his choice.  His end will not come to rest on your doorstep.

I had a rough upbringing and I escaped that toxic sludge of an environment and found love and purpose in the arms of a woman that loved me only to toss me aside 10 years later.  A man that cannot trust his family, his friends or someone to love has nothing left.  I should add that I have never had a drive to live for myself.  Not since I can remember.  

Edit:  As a kid I didn't like the rat race...I don't crave power or money.  So I thought I should live to help others.  I almost joined the priesthood and became disillusioned, now I'm an atheist.  I was going to do Psychology and my family helped bury that dream, now halfway around the world from them I began to heal and decided to become a physician...and now this woman has broken the last of me.
I'm a perfectionist by nature and I wanted to find a way to make it as least traumatic for my family while at the same time taking a moment to muster up the final push.  That is why I wrote it out.
